svg.text: Lovebox Perfboard Wiring — Bottom View (solder side)
This is the BOTTOM of the board — what you see while soldering. Components are on the other side.
All colored wires exit UPWARD through the perfboard
They go through holes and connect to the OLED, servo, and LDR on the top/other layers
Gold circles = ESP32 pins. Yellow labels = pins we use. Gray labels = unused pins.
This is the BOTTOM (solder side). Everything is mirrored from the top.
